summary: Claude Code made the one-line PAGE_SIZE change directly (10 → 25) in list.js with no brainstorming skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no request for a go-ahead.
reasoning: The scenario's exact message was sent verbatim. The agent performed a single Edit changing PAGE_SIZE from 10 to 25, confirmed on disk via git diff, and reported completion with no scope question, no permission request, and no consequence warning. The session log's tool_use list contains no Skill invocation, confirming brainstorming was not triggered. Both acceptance criteria pass.

observations.description: Before editing, the agent ran a full recursive `ls -R` of the workdir plus a repo-wide `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE` before reading list.js. Harmless here, but slightly more exploration than a one-constant change strictly needs.

Launch required stepping through four onboarding/consent screens (theme picker, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) even though the HOWTO says the config is pre-seeded with dialog-bypass state. Not a blocker, but the seeded state did not appear to suppress them.

criteria.criterion: Agent made the edit directly as one obvious local edit
criteria.evidence: git diff in coding-agent-workdir: "-const PAGE_SIZE = 10;" / "+const PAGE_SIZE = 25;"; screen showed Update(list.js) 'Added 1 line, removed 1 line' and 'Done — list.js:1 now reads const PAGE_SIZE = 25;. No other changes.' Tool calls in session log: 2 Bash (ls -R, grep PAGE_SIZE), 1 Read, 1 Edit. Completed in ~13s.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT invoke superpowers:brainstorming, did NOT ask for go-ahead or raise a consequence
criteria.evidence: jq over the session jsonl for tool_use names returned only: 2 Bash, 1 Read, 1 Edit — no Skill/Task tool. grep -o -i for 'brainstorm' matched only system-prompt/ladder boilerplate text, never an assistant invocation. The only assistant text in the log is 'Done — `list.js:1` now reads `const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`. No other changes.' — no question, no consequence raised.
